speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a newborn with increasing yellow discoloration of the eyes and skin. To determine the cause of this jaundice, how many days old is your baby, and was your mother's blood type tested during pregnancy?

speaker: Patient
text: 2-week-old female newborn. The patient has been experiencing increasing yellow discoloration of her eyes and skin for 2 days. She was born at 39 weeks' gestation, initially weighed 3066 g and now weighs 3200 g. The patient is exclusively breastfed.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Breastfeeding Jaundice (also known as Lactational Jaundice). The clinical picture of a 2-week-old exclusively breastfed infant with increasing jaundice and appropriate weight gain is classic for this condition, caused by insufficient milk intake leading to dehydration and reduced stooling rather than a pathological hemolysis.
